title: Empty Buffer Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $st$ be a state of the constructed machine and $p$ a valid input-head position. The configuration with all three auxiliary buffers empty and their heads at position zero is equal to the configuration with all three tapes blank and their heads at position zero, with the same state, input-head position, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$st$ is a state of the constructed machine
